sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists three Corinth Selectboard members: Carl Demrow, Stephen Devoto, and Holly Groschner.

Town of Corinth official website, Town Officers page: lists the Selectboard as Carl Demrow (term ends 2029), Stephen Devoto (2027), and Holly Groschner (2028), with Groschner marked as Chair; the March 3, 2026 Town Meeting minutes are signed by her as Selectboard Chair.
Town of Corinth official website, Town Officers page: lists the Moderator (1-year term, ends 2027) as Gary Apfel.
Town of Corinth, March 3, 2026 Town Meeting voting results (posted on corinthvt.org): record 'Town Moderator for 1 year -- WINNER: Gary Apfel'.
Town of Corinth official website, Town Officers page: lists the Town Clerk (3-year term, ends 2029) as Martha Brough.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Martha Brough as Town Clerk of Corinth.

Town of Corinth, Annual Report 2025 (FY2025): the officers table prints 'TREASURER -vacant-', and the town's Town Officers page directs treasurer matters to an Interim Assistant Treasurer (a staff position). Structure only: the office is vacant; no holder is recorded rather than guessed.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists the Corinth Town Treasurer position as vacant.
Town of Corinth official website, Town Officers page: lists three Listers: KellyAnn Donahue (Chair, term ends 2028), Marsha Blake (2028), and Mary B. Martin (2027).

Town of Corinth, March 3, 2026 Town Meeting voting results (posted on corinthvt.org): record the March 3, 2026 winners: 'Lister for 1 year -- WINNER: Mary B Martin' and 'Lister for 2 years -- WINNER: Marsha R Blake'.
Town of Corinth official website, Town Officers page: lists the Collector of Delinquent Taxes (1-year term, ends 2027) as Raymond Moulton.
Town of Corinth, March 3, 2026 Town Meeting voting results (posted on corinthvt.org): record 'Delinquent Tax Collector for 1 year -- WINNER: Raymond Moulton'.
Town of Corinth official website, Town Officers page: lists three Cemetery Commissioners (3-year terms): Luke Campbell (ends 2027), Norman Collette (Chair, 2029), and Raymond Moulton (2028).
Town of Corinth, March 3, 2026 Town Meeting voting results (posted on corinthvt.org): record 'Cemetery Commissioner for 3 years -- WINNER: Norm Collette'.

Town of Corinth official website, Town Officers page: lists the Constable office (1-year term) as vacant. Structure only: no official source publishes a current holder; the seat is left unfilled rather than guessed.
Town of Corinth official website, Town Officers page: lists the Road Commissioner (3-year term, ends 2027) as Lee Porter among the town's appointed officers. The holder is recorded as appointed.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Corinth justices of the peace: Kathy Chapman, Jane Conner, Anne Margolis, Tim O'Dell, Russ Pazdro, Amy Peberdy, and Allegra Shumway.
Town of Corinth official website, Town Officers page: lists the same seven justices of the peace (2-year terms expiring January 31, 2027).
